title: Utilization Management Turnaround Standards for Prior Authorization
content:
**Standard.** Prairie Ridge Health Plan decides each Prior Authorization request within the timeframe of its class: a standard request within a number of calendar days after its received date, an expedited request within a number of hours after receipt. The decision deadline may be extended once, by no more than the class's review-extension maximum. A request may be pended for clinical information no more than the class's pend limit, and the requesting provider has the class's response period to answer each information request.

| Class | Standard decision (calendar days after received date) | Expedited decision (hours after receipt) | Most review-extension days (once) | Provider response period to a pend (calendar days) | Most pends per request |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | 7 | 72 | 14 | 10 | 1 |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | 7 | 72 | 14 | 10 | 1 |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | 7 | 72 | 14 | 10 | 2 |
| Home Health Services Authorization | 7 | 72 | 14 | 10 | 1 |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | 7 | 72 | 14 | 5 | 1 |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | 7 | 72 | 14 | 5 | 1 |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | 7 | 72 | 14 | 10 | 2 |

**Notes to the table.**

1. The response period is the calendar days the requesting provider has to answer a request for clinical information before the request is decided on the record as it stands.
2. The review-extension figure is the most calendar days by which the decision deadline may be extended, and the extension is taken once.
3. The pend limit is the most times one request may be pended for information over its life.

**Hypothetical reading.** A hypothetical Durable Medical Equipment Authorization request may be pended twice, with 10 calendar days for each answer; a hypothetical Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization request may be pended once, with 5 calendar days for the answer. Both are decided on the standard track within 7 calendar days of the received date, or within 72 hours when expedited.
